# 4-actions/

## Purpose

This folder contains **generated action specifications** that define backend endpoints and frontend pages.

## Generated Files

When following the `.ai-control` framework, AI will generate these files in Phase 2:

- **`endpoints.md`** — Complete backend API specification with routes, methods, DTOs, and constraints
- **`pages.md`** — Complete frontend page specification with routes, components, services, and states

## Usage

These files are generated from:
- All planning documents in `3-plan/`
- Rule documents in `5-rules/`
- `2-templates/` (structured templates)

Do not manually create these files. Follow the orchestration steps in `start.md` to generate them consistently.

## Status

This folder starts empty. Files appear here as you progress through Phase 2 of the framework.
